title: Three manufacturing accounts distinguish line results from capacity claims
summary: Current Applications, Island Components and Monaghan Medical gain eighteen substantive sections and nine dated entries from sixteen inspected primary HTML records. Earlier employment findings, investment commitments and comparison decisions remain separately dated.
evidence_note: The Current Applications multiplier discrepancy remains visible. Cancelled grant funding, whole-company employment, group certification listings, annual shipment claims and clinical outcomes retain distinct meanings. The exact FDA query failed; no alternate query or new event count was substituted. Thirteen historical notices preserve the applicable earlier findings.
publication_effect: Local source integration only; production rendering, release and launch remain unverified.
